name: Restaurant Pizzeria La Famiglia
kurzbeschreibung: **Restaurant Pizzeria La Famiglia in Zirl** – Enjoy authentic Italian flavors in the heart of Tirol, just a short drive from Innsbruck. Their handmade pizzas, fresh pasta, and classic dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert make every meal a delight. A cozy spot for families, couples, and pizza lovers alike.
